facilitySpecialtyEffectiveDate.description: Effective date for the facility specialty (YYYY-MM-DD)

facilitySpecialtyIsPrimary.description: Indicates if the specialty is primary

certifyLocationId.description: Certify location ID to associate the specialty at the facility-location level

facilityLocationSpecialtyEffectiveDate.description: Effective date for the facility location specialty (YYYY-MM-DD)

facilityLocationSpecialtyIsPrimary.description: Indicates if the location specialty is primary

certifyGroupId.description: Certify group ID to associate the specialty at the group-facility level

certifyNetworkId.description: Certify network ID to associate the specialty at the group-facility-network level (requires certifyGroupId)

groupSpecialtyEffectiveDate.description: Effective date for the group facility specialty (YYYY-MM-DD)

locationSpecialtyEffectiveDate.description: Effective date for the group facility location specialty (YYYY-MM-DD). Triggers group-location specialty creation when both certifyGroupId and certifyLocationId are provided.

networkSpecialtyEffectiveDate.description: Effective date for the group facility network specialty (YYYY-MM-DD)
